body.message:
Please note that we are unable to guarantee the same rate for the upcoming months, as our rates are dynamic and may change according to current market conditions and availability.

However, the quoted rate is all-inclusive, covering:DEWA,Wi-Fi,DTCM fees,VAT

Additionally, a refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The deposit will be fully refunded at check-out, provided there are no damages or outstanding charges related to the apartment.

The refund will be processed within 7 working days after your departure.
